measures.what: Please tell me the tripod/head brand and model, and camera model (plus lens). Describe the empty plate receiver: does it have a sliding clamp, a snap-in latch, or a threaded socket? If possible, measure its opening length and width in mm. Also, do you have the listed salvaged 1/4-20 webcam-mount bolt available?
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.item: tripod clamp, camera, and available metal camera bolt
measures.what: 38 mm alone does not identify the plate shape. Can you find a tripod/head model marking? Does its clamp tighten with a knob onto two sloping edges (often called Arca), or does a lever snap around a shaped plate? Measure the required plate thickness and edge slope/profile if you can. Also confirm camera+lens weight, and whether you have the salvaged 1/4-20 webcam bolt; if so measure its under-head length, head diameter and head height.
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head); tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: Please measure (1) jaw contact length along the plate; (2) vertical height from the receiver floor to the top of the angled lips; (3) width between lips at floor and at their top, with knob left in the same position. A head model marking would help confirm the profile. For the camera, measure socket usable depth gently with a nonmetallic probe (do not force it), and describe the flat base area around it. Can you give camera+lens weight, or model? If any measurement isn't possible, say so; we can test a small dummy plate without risking the camera.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.item: printed clamp_fit_coupon in tripod clamp, with no camera attached
measures.what: With the knob loosened, does the coupon sit flat on the receiver floor? Tighten gently: do BOTH angled edges get captured, with no rocking, lift-out, or sliding under a firm hand pull? Does the top deck clear the jaws? Answer yes/no/unsure for each. Separately, can you confirm safe camera screw insertion depth from its manual or measure the socket depth gently? Without these checks I cannot approve this for holding a camera.
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)
